title: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
title_zh: DuoMatching：用于少步视频生成的联合-边缘分布匹配

paragraphs.en: Streaming video generation has benefited from distribution matching distillation (DMD), which matches the joint distribution of video frames to a video teacher’s approximation of the real video distribution. Although this joint matching mitigates drift during autoregressive rollouts, limitations remain in visual quality and semantic alignment. To address these limitations, we propose DuoMatching, a distribution matching framework that approximates the real video distribution through a unified joint-marginal formulation. On top of existing joint matching formulations, the additional marginal matching objective provides dedicated frame-level supervision from an image generator, transferring complementary visual and semantic priors from it. To apply this frame-level supervision in video generation, we introduce LatentBridge to resolve the latent representation mismatch between the video student and the image teacher. Latent Variation Sampling further distributes such frame-level supervision across distinct temporal segments, reducing redundancy. Experiments demonstrate that DuoMatching improves visual quality, composition, and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion dynamics. Human evaluations show overall preference rates above 80% against all evaluated baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 视频流生成技术得益于分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），该方法将视频帧的联合分布与视频教师模型对真实视频分布的近似值进行匹配。 尽管这种联合匹配能在自回归生成过程中缓解漂移问题，但视觉质量和语义对齐方面仍存在局限性。 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 DuoMatching——一种通过统一的联合-边缘公式来近似真实视频分布的匹配框架。 在现有联合匹配公式的基础上，额外的边缘匹配目标引入了来自图像生成器的专用帧级监督，从而传递其互补的视觉和语义先验知识。 为了在视频生成中应用这种帧级监督，我们引入了 LatentBridge，以解决视频学生模型与图像教师模型之间的潜在表示不匹配问题。 潜在变化采样进一步将这种帧级监督分布到不同的时间片段中，从而减少冗余。 实验表明，DuoMatching 提升了视觉质量、构图和语义对齐效果，同时基本保留了动态运动特征。 人类评估结果显示，与所有被评估的基线模型相比，整体偏好率均超过 80%。

paragraphs.en: Recent video generation models have achieved remarkable advances in visual quality and temporal coherence [ 20 , 41 ] . Despite their impressive performance, these models typically require many sequential denoising steps, resulting in substantial computational cost and inference latency that hinder real-time applications such as interactive world simulation [ 24 ] and digital entertainment [ 49 ] . Recently, distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 43 ] addresses this computational bottleneck by distilling multi-step diffusion [ 10 ] or flow models [ 18 ] into few-step generators. Although streaming video generation built on this paradigm has approached real-time inference [ 30 , 40 , 19 ] , preserving generation quality under distribution matching remains a challenge [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频生成模型在视觉质量和时间连贯性方面取得了显著进展 [ 20 , 41 ] 。 尽管这些模型表现优异，但它们通常需要许多顺序的去噪步骤，导致巨大的计算成本和推理延迟，从而阻碍了实时应用（如交互式世界模拟 [ 24 ] 和数字娱乐 [ 49 ] ）的发展。 最近，分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）[ 43 ] 通过将多步扩散模型 [ 10 ] 或流模型 [ 18 ] 蒸馏为少步生成器，解决了这一计算瓶颈问题。 尽管基于该范式的流式视频生成已接近实时推理水平 [ 30 , 40 , 19 ] ，但在分布匹配下保持生成质量仍然是一个挑战 [ 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we identify remaining limitations in visual quality and semantic alignment of autoregressive generators trained with existing DMD methods. These methods use the video teacher’s distribution as a proxy for the real video distribution [ 43 ] and match the joint distribution of all frames, a formulation we refer to as joint DMD. As shown in Figure 1 , the quantitative results indicate that joint DMD substantially mitigates drift over the rollout, but yields only limited improvement in initial-frame quality. The qualitative comparison highlights remaining limitations in visual quality and semantic alignment, as illustrated by insufficient fine-grained fur detail and the missing feather in this example. These frame-level deficiencies suggest that existing DMD methods do not adequately model the marginal distribution, i.e., the distribution of individual frames. Indeed, existing DMD matches marginals jointly with cross-frame dependencies, without a dedicated objective for individual frames. Adding an additional marginal distribution constraint in training may better approximate the real video distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们识别出使用现有 DMD 方法训练的自回归生成器在视觉质量和语义对齐方面仍存在局限性。 这些方法将视频教师的分布用作真实视频分布的代理，并匹配所有帧的联合分布，我们将这种形式称为联合 DMD [43]。 如图 1 所示，定量结果表明，联合 DMD 显著减轻了生成过程中的漂移问题，但仅能有限地提升初始帧的质量。 定性对比凸显了视觉质量和语义对齐方面仍存在的局限性，例如本例中毛发细节不足且缺少羽毛。 这些帧级缺陷表明，现有 DMD 方法未能充分建模边缘分布，即单个帧的分布。 实际上，现有 DMD 方法在匹配边缘分布时同时考虑了跨帧依赖关系，而未为单个帧设置专门的优化目标。 在训练中加入额外的边缘分布约束，或许能更准确地逼近真实视频分布。

paragraphs.en: To model the marginal distribution in video generation, we employ image generation models [ 27 , 3 ] which provide a natural frame-level reference distribution. Their strong priors support fine-grained appearance modeling, and their semantic alignment capabilities also help capture prompt-specified attributes and spatial relationships. Marginal distribution matching directly steers the student’s frame-level distribution toward the image teacher’s distribution, without being constrained by cross-frame dependencies. As illustrated in Figure 2 , the marginal distribution matching’s signal exhibits more coherent spatial structure, with particularly strong responses on the subject’s overly smooth black clothing. Together with the video teacher’s joint distribution, the additional marginal distribution from image teachers guides the student to generate more realistic video.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对视频生成中的边缘分布进行建模，我们采用了图像生成模型 [27, 3]，这些模型提供了自然的帧级参考分布。 它们强大的先验知识支持了对外观的精细建模，其语义对齐能力也有助于捕捉提示词中指定的属性和空间关系。 边缘分布匹配直接引导学生模型的帧级分布向图像教师模型的分布靠拢，而不会受到跨帧依赖关系的限制。 如图 2 所示，边缘分布匹配的信号展现出更连贯的空间结构，尤其是在主体过于平滑的黑色衣物上表现出特别强烈的响应。 结合视频教师的联合分布，来自图像教师的额外边缘分布引导学生模型生成更加逼真的视频。

paragraphs.en: We propose DuoMatching, a distribution matching framework that approximates the real video distribution through a unified joint-marginal formulation. For few-step video generation, we instantiate this formulation by training a video generator with a weighted combination of joint DMD and marginal DMD. Specifically, we sample a subset of frames from each generated video and apply marginal DMD independently to each frame using the image teacher, transferring visual and semantic priors to strengthen frame-level supervision. Joint DMD supervises the full sequence using the video teacher, constraining cross-frame dependencies to encourage temporal consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DuoMatching，这是一种分布匹配框架，通过统一的联合-边缘公式来近似真实的视频分布。 对于少步视频生成，我们通过训练一个视频生成器来实现这一公式，该生成器结合了加权后的联合 DMD 和边缘 DMD。 具体来说，我们从每个生成的视频中采样一部分帧，并使用图像教师对每一帧独立应用边缘 DMD，从而将视觉和语义先验知识转移过去，以增强帧级监督。 联合 DMD 则使用视频教师对整个序列进行监督，约束跨帧依赖关系，以促进时间一致性。

paragraphs.en: Still, applying marginal distribution matching to a video student is nontrivial. Applying marginal DMD requires frame-level representations compatible with the image teacher. However, temporally compressed video latents do not directly correspond to individual frames, and video and image VAEs may use incompatible latent spaces. Therefore, we propose LatentBridge , a lightweight module that resolves the latent representation mismatch, enabling frame-level distribution matching without substantially suppressing encoded dynamics. We further introduce Latent Variation Sampling (LVS) to distribute marginal matching across distinct temporal segments, reducing redundant supervision to better balance visual quality and video dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，将边际分布匹配应用于视频学生并非易事。 应用边际 DMD 需要与图像教师兼容的帧级表示。 但是，时间上压缩的视频潜在变量并不直接对应于单个帧，而且视频和图像的 VAE 可能使用不兼容的潜在空间。 因此，我们提出了 LatentBridge——一个轻量级模块，用于解决潜在表示的不匹配问题，从而能够在不显著抑制编码动态性的情况下实现帧级分布匹配。 我们还引入了潜在变化采样（LVS），将边际匹配分布在不同的时间片段中，以减少冗余监督，更好地平衡视觉质量与视频动态性。

paragraphs.en: Few-step video generation. Recent video generation models [ 20 , 26 , 36 ] achieve strong visual quality but rely on expensive iterative denoising, motivating the development of few-step generation methods. Some works adopt adversarial post-training to enable one-step video generation [ 17 ] , while others reduce sampling steps through model distillation [ 15 , 5 ] . VideoLCM [ 34 ] extends consistency distillation to video generation. CausVid [ 44 ] uses DMD [ 42 ] for autoregressive video generation, enabling KV-cache reuse. Subsequent works address different limitations of causal distillation: Self Forcing [ 11 ] reduces the mismatch between training and self-generated inference rollouts, while Causal Forcing [ 50 ] addresses the architectural mismatch to ensure frame-level injectivity. DuoMatching instead investigates the persistent quality limitations of distribution matching itself to improve the generation quality of few-step generators.
paragraphs.zh: 少步视频生成。 近期的视频生成模型 [ 20 , 26 , 36 ] 虽然实现了出色的视觉质量，但依赖成本高昂的迭代去噪过程，这推动了少步生成方法的发展。 一些研究采用对抗性后训练来实现单步视频生成 [ 17 ]，而另一些研究则通过模型蒸馏来减少采样步数 [ 15 , 5 ]。 VideoLCM [ 34 ] 将一致性蒸馏扩展到了视频生成领域。 CausVid [ 44 ] 利用 DMD [ 42 ] 进行自回归视频生成，从而实现了 KV-cache 的重复使用。 后续研究针对因果蒸馏的不同局限性提出了改进方案：Self Forcing [ 11 ] 减少了训练与自生成推理过程之间的不匹配，而 Causal Forcing [ 50 ] 则解决了架构不匹配问题，以确保帧级别的单射性。 DuoMatching 则转而研究分布匹配本身持续存在的质量局限性，以提升少步生成器的生成质量。

sents.en: DuoMatching instead investigates the persistent quality limitations of distribution matching itself to improve the generation quality of few-step generators.

paragraphs.en: Distribution matching. Distribution matching provides a general framework for generative modeling by aligning the generated distribution with the real data distribution [ 42 , 43 , 35 ] . However, the matching process can still suffer from optimization instability. Phased DMD [ 6 ] eases multi-step optimization by decomposing the denoising process into smaller SNR intervals. Beyond improving the optimization itself, several works introduce additional supervision to enhance the matched distribution. One-Forcing [ 7 ] adds adversarial supervision to alleviate frame blurring at extremely low NFE, while Reward Forcing [ 21 ] and DMDR [ 13 ] incorporate reward signals to favor preferred outputs. Data-Forcing [ 4 ] leverages real data to mitigate the mode-seeking behavior of DMD, whereas SA-DMD [ 39 ] anchors distribution matching to the source video for better content preservation in video editing. DuoMatching complements joint distribution matching with direct marginal distribution matching to more stably approximate the real video distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 分布匹配。 分布匹配通过使生成的分布与真实数据分布对齐，为生成式建模提供了一个通用框架 [ 42 , 43 , 35 ] 。 然而，匹配过程仍然可能受到优化不稳定的影响。 分阶段 DMD [ 6 ] 通过将去噪过程分解为更小的 SNR 区间，简化了多步优化。 除了优化优化过程本身之外，一些研究还引入了额外的监督机制来增强匹配后的分布。 One-Forcing [ 7 ] 增加了对抗性监督，以缓解在极低 NFE 下的帧模糊问题，而 Reward Forcing [ 21 ] 和 DMDR [ 13 ] 则整合了奖励信号，以优先选择更理想的输出。 Data-Forcing [ 4 ] 利用真实数据来减轻 DMD 的模式寻求行为，而 SA-DMD [ 39 ] 则将分布匹配锚定到源视频上，以便在视频编辑中更好地保留内容。 DuoMatching 通过结合联合分布匹配与直接的边缘分布匹配，更稳定地逼近真实视频分布，从而对分布匹配方法形成补充。

paragraphs.en: Image priors for video generation. Image priors support video generation through image animation [ 31 , 8 ] , and initialization from pretrained image models [ 29 , 2 , 1 ] . Beyond initialization, image generation models have been integrated into video sampling to improve visual quality [ 46 , 28 ] . Some works have also explored incorporating image priors through distribution matching to accelerate video generation, focusing on image-derived video models such as AnimateDiff [ 9 ] . MCM [ 45 ] introduces a discriminator trained on image data during consistency distillation, while AVDM2 [ 51 ] incorporates score distribution matching using an image teacher to enhance video adversarial training. We revisit distribution matching from a joint-marginal perspective, theoretically analyze the relationship between joint and marginal matching, and formulate both as distribution matching objectives within DuoMatching. We further introduce LatentBridge to generalize this framework to modern video generators with temporally compressed latents.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成的图像先验。 图像先验通过图像动画 [ 31 , 8 ] 和预训练图像模型的初始化 [ 29 , 2 , 1 ] 来支持视频生成。 除了初始化之外，图像生成模型还被整合到视频采样中以提高视觉质量 [ 46 , 28 ] 。 一些研究还探索了通过分布匹配引入图像先验以加速视频生成，重点关注基于图像的动态视频模型，例如 AnimateDiff [ 9 ] 。 MCM [ 45 ] 在一致性蒸馏过程中引入了一个在图像数据上训练的判别器，而 AVDM2 [ 51 ] 则利用图像教师模型进行分数分布匹配，以增强视频的对抗性训练。 我们从联合-边缘视角重新审视了分布匹配，理论上分析了联合匹配与边缘匹配之间的关系，并在 DuoMatching 中将两者都构造成分布匹配目标。 我们进一步引入了 LatentBridge，将该框架推广到具有时间压缩潜变量的现代视频生成器。

paragraphs.en: Because we use image generation models to approximate the marginal distribution, an additional issue arises from the difference between image VAE encoding and video VAE encoding. Most video VAEs [ 48 ] use temporal compression, where one video latent maps to multiple actual RGB frames, while each image latent is constrained to one frame. A straightforward solution is to decode video latents into RGB frames and re-encode them with the image VAE, but backpropagating matching gradients through both VAEs incurs substantial memory overhead.

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. For causal models, we initialize the generator from the causal consistency distillation checkpoint from Causal Forcing++ [ 47 ] and subsequently optimize it with DMD on VidProM [ 33 ] for 1,000 training steps. For bidirectional models, following CausVid [ 44 ] , we initialize the generator directly from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B and perform DMD training for 1200 steps on Mixkit [ 16 ] . In both settings, we use the frozen Qwen-Image [ 37 ] as the default image teacher. The output videos consist of 81 81 frames and have a resolution of H = 480 H{=}480 , W = 832 W{=}832 . LatentBridge is trained separately on a curated subset of OpenVid [ 23 ] containing 29,400 videos with high aesthetic quality and substantial motion. For DuoMatching, we set the marginal DMD loss weight to ω = 0.4 \omega=0.4 and sample K = 4 K=4 temporal latent slices from each video by default. All experiments are conducted on eight GPUs, each with 80 GB of memory.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative results. The quantitative results in Table 1 show DuoMatching’s significant advantages over the compared methods within each matched generation mode and NFE budget. For bidirectional generation, DuoMatching improves upon CausVid in visual quality, semantic alignment, and video dynamics. For causal generation, DuoMatching achieves higher video generation quality across one-, two-, and four-step settings, yielding considerable improvements in visual quality and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion quality. These results support our joint-marginal formulation, which improves frame-level quality through explicit marginal matching and complementary visual and semantic priors from pretrained image generation models. All gains are achieved without additional inference computation, preserving the real-time generation capability of Causal Forcing++ [ 47 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果。 表 1 中的定量结果表明，在每种匹配生成模式和 NFE 预算下，DuoMatching 相较于其他对比方法均展现出显著优势。 在双向生成中，DuoMatching 在视觉质量、语义对齐和视频动态性方面优于 CausVid。 在因果生成中，DuoMatching 在一步、两步和四步设置下均实现了更高的视频生成质量，在显著提升视觉质量和语义对齐的同时，基本保留了运动质量。 这些结果支持我们的联合边缘公式，该公式通过显式的边缘匹配以及预训练图像生成模型提供的互补视觉和语义先验，提升了帧级质量。 所有性能提升均未增加额外的推理计算量，从而保留了 Causal Forcing++ [47] 的实时生成能力。

paragraphs.en: Enabling frame-level marginal matching with LatentBridge. We investigate the role of LatentBridge in enabling marginal matching. Qwen-Image and Wan share the same VAE encoder, allowing us to directly apply marginal DMD to temporally compressed video latent slices as a baseline. As shown in Table 4 , such direct application improves semantic alignment and visual quality, but suppresses the dynamic information encoded in the latent representation, resulting in videos with limited motion. By mapping temporally compressed video latents to frame-specific image latents, LatentBridge separates spatial information in video latents and aligns it with the target image latent space. LatentBridge yields further gains in visual quality and semantic alignment while largely retaining video dynamics. While Decode-Encode runs out of memory under our training configuration, LatentBridge incurs only a small additional memory overhead over the Direct baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 通过 LatentBridge 实现帧级边缘匹配。 我们研究了 LatentBridge 在实现边缘匹配中的作用。 Qwen-Image 和 Wan 共享相同的 VAE 编码器，因此我们可以直接将边缘 DMD 应用于时间压缩的视频潜在切片，以此作为基线方法。 如表 4 所示，这种直接应用虽然提升了语义对齐和视觉质量，但抑制了潜在表示中编码的动态信息，导致视频的运动表现受限。 通过将时间压缩的视频潜在表示映射到特定帧的图像潜在表示，LatentBridge 分离了视频潜在表示中的空间信息，并将其与目标图像潜在空间对齐。 LatentBridge 在进一步提升视觉质量和语义对齐的同时，基本保留了视频的动态特性。 尽管在我们的训练配置下 Decode-Encode 会因内存不足而中断运行，但 LatentBridge 相较于 Direct 基线方法仅带来少量额外的内存开销。

paragraphs.en: We presented DuoMatching, a unified joint-marginal distribution matching framework for few-step video generation. By complementing joint DMD with explicit marginal DMD, our framework strengthens frame-level supervision and transfers visual and semantic priors from image models. LatentBridge enables marginal matching for temporally compressed video latents, while Latent Variation Sampling reduces redundant supervision. Experiments demonstrate improvements in visual quality, composition, and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DuoMatching，一个用于少步视频生成的统一联合-边际分布匹配框架。 通过将显式边际 DMD 与联合 DMD 相结合，我们的框架增强了帧级监督，并从图像模型中迁移了视觉和语义先验知识。 LatentBridge 支持对时间压缩的视频潜在表示进行边际匹配，而 Latent Variation Sampling 则减少了冗余的监督。 实验表明，该框架在提升视觉质量、构图和语义对齐的同时，基本保留了运动动态。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 presents additional qualitative comparisons with Reward Forcing, One-Forcing, and CausVid. Compared with Reward Forcing, DuoMatching renders the ice dragon with more clearly defined structures and finer details, while better preserving the boxer’s appearance during rapid motion. In the pianist example, it also produces a more plausible spatial relationship between the pianist, keyboard, and piano, better reflecting the intended interaction. Compared with One-Forcing and CausVid, DuoMatching alleviates overexposure and produces more realistic results, with more natural lighting and richer details in animal fur, feathers, clothing, and surrounding environments. In particular, under the N ​ F ​ E = 1 NFE=1 setting, DuoMatching substantially improves motion stability over One-Forcing, reducing abrupt changes in subject appearance and position across frames. Together, these examples illustrate improvements in generation quality across different video distillation baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了与 Reward Forcing、One-Forcing 和 CausVid 的更多定性对比。 与 Reward Forcing 相比，DuoMatching 生成的冰龙结构更清晰、细节更精细，同时在快速运动中更好地保留了拳击手的外形。 在钢琴家示例中，它还能生成钢琴家、键盘和钢琴之间更合理的空间关系，更准确地反映了预期的互动。 与 One-Forcing 和 CausVid 相比，DuoMatching 减轻了过度曝光问题，并生成了更逼真的结果，光照更自然，动物毛发、羽毛、衣物及周围环境也更具细节。 特别是在 N ​ F ​ E = 1 NFE=1 的设置下，DuoMatching 显著提升了相对于 One-Forcing 的运动稳定性，减少了主体外观和位置在各帧之间的突兀变化。 综合来看，这些示例展示了在不同视频蒸馏基线方法中生成质量的提升。

paragraphs.en: LatentBridge provides a lightweight mapping between video and image latent spaces. LatentBridge consists of eight FiLM residual blocks with 256 hidden channels, totaling only 10.75M trainable parameters. It is trained on 29,400 videos at 480p resolution with an effective batch size of 32. Training for 3,000 iterations takes approximately 15 minutes on eight 80-GB GPUs. Despite its compact size and short training time, LatentBridge produces reconstructions that closely match the targets in scene structure and visual details, as shown in Figure 6 . The examples across Qwen-Image, FLUX, and SDXL further illustrate its applicability to different image latent spaces.
paragraphs.zh: LatentBridge 在视频和图像潜在空间之间提供了一种轻量级的映射方法。 LatentBridge 由八个 FiLM 残差块组成，每个块包含 256 个隐藏通道，总训练参数仅为 1075 万。 该模型在 480p 分辨率的 29,400 个视频上进行训练，有效批量大小为 32。 在八块 80GB GPU 上训练 3,000 次迭代大约需要 15 分钟。 尽管体积小巧且训练时间较短，LatentBridge 生成的重建结果在场景结构和视觉细节上与目标高度一致，如图 6 所示。 Qwen-Image、FLUX 和 SDXL 中的示例进一步证明了其在不同图像潜在空间中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the training procedure of DuoMatching. The generator is optimized with joint DMD and marginal DMD, while both fake estimators are updated on freshly generated samples. The teachers and LatentBridge remain frozen, with gradients propagated through LatentBridge during generator updates.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了 DuoMatching 的训练流程。 生成器通过联合 DMD 和边际 DMD 进行优化，同时两个虚假估计器均在新生成的样本上进行更新。 教师模型和 LatentBridge 保持冻结状态，在生成器更新期间，梯度会通过 LatentBridge 传播。
